name: Wellcome Trust
collect_note: Reads the Climate Impacts Awards scheme page twice a day for the labelled 'by 15:00 BST on <date>' submission deadline and creates one call per cycle only while that date is in the future; the 2026 round (8 April 2026) is closed, so no call is open until Wellcome posts the next date.

zero_reason.quote: Your application must be submitted by 15.00 BST on 8 April 2026 on the deadline day.
zero_reason.filter_test: deadline_regex matches the last known round's own line 'submitted by 15:00 BST on 8 April 2026' (date 2026-04-08, past, so no item)

evidence: Channels tried 2026-11-20. endpoint_recon (--chrome down, plain only): verdict html_ok, no feed, no API; __NEXT_DATA__ on the scheme page holds only in-page nav links. Funder-wide listing https://wellcome.org/research-funding/schemes is client-rendered from a __NEXT_DATA__ JSON blob (10 schemes, Climate Impacts Awards has scheme_status Open, scheme_accepting_applications 'Closed to applications', frequency Annual, scheme_closes_for_applications empty, scheme_opens_for_applications '20 January 2026'); no anchors in the plain HTML so the html list adapter cannot read it, and the only JSON route is /_next/data/<buildId>/research-funding/schemes.json (HTTP 200 locally) whose buildId changes with every deploy, so it is not stable. /api/search-listing/funding-schemes, /feed and /research-funding/funding-opportunities return 404; sitemap.xml returns a 302/550-byte index with no scheme hits. The scheme page is plain HTML (about 80k chars), states the annual frequency and the labelled 2026 deadline; its 'Upcoming application stage' block is JavaScript-rendered ('Calculating next key date') so the next round date is unknown today.
